reasons: B drops the leading comma in the virtual-table parameters (Остатки(" + ТекстФильтра + ")), so the filter condition lands in the Период parameter and the query is invalid. A keeps the comma (Остатки(, ...)), so the filter stays in the condition parameter and correctly returns the total over all characteristics when none is passed. Otherwise the two are nearly identical.

B: Builds РегистрНакопления.ТоварыНаСкладах.Остатки(<условие>) without the leading comma, so the condition is passed as the Период parameter and the query fails.
